# Dental Economics

> Dental Economics is the leading resource for dental practice management, clinical innovation, and professional development covering business strategy, patient communication, technology trends, and dentist wellness.

Dental Economics provides comprehensive coverage of practice management, clinical updates, and business intelligence for dental professionals. The publication features expert guidance from industry leaders like the Levin Group and covers critical topics including practice valuation, patient financing, infection control, and leadership during industry disruption.

## Key Topics

- Practice Management
- Case Acceptance
- Patient Financing
- Practice Valuation
- Dental Technology
- Patient Communication
- Burnout Prevention
- Dentist Wellness
- Infection Control
- Team Leadership
- Practice Culture
- Patient Loyalty
- PPO Alternatives
- Digital Transformation
- Clinical Guidelines

## Clinical & Technology

- [Clinical + Tech](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech): Hub for clinical updates, product reviews, and dental technology innovation
- [Technology Trends](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/macro-op-ed/technology-trends): Topic hub covering AI, digital transformation, and clinical automation trends
- [Promoting infection control practices in your dental office](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/14173407/promoting-infection-control-practices-in-your-dental-office): Michelle Strange discusses infection control protocols and patient safety benefits
- [Evidence-based care and COVID-19](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/14183306/evidence-based-care-and-covid-19): Fiona M. Collins on evidence-based dentistry protocols and clinical guidelines
- [Product review: Speed2Treat Kit by QuickSplint](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/14183256/product-review-speed2treat-kit-by-quicksplint): Dr. Joshua Austin reviews QuickSplint TMJ treatment product and clinical use

## Practice Management & Leadership

- [Takeaways from top dental practices: It's not about superstars](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14188807/takeaways-from-top-dental-practices-its-not-about-superstars): Levin Group analysis on systems-driven success in top-performing practices
- [Crafting the culture of your dental practice](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14178985/crafting-the-culture-of-your-dental-practice): Dr. Chris Salierno on building practice culture through leadership and values
- [Ask Jay: How do I keep my team focused during seasonal distractions?](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14072346/ask-jay-how-do-i-keep-my-team-focused-during-seasonal-distractions): Jay Geier advises on team engagement and productivity during seasonal periods
- [Your people and your leadership in the time of COVID-19: Top 5 areas of focus](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14186685/your-people-and-your-leadership-in-the-time-of-covid-19-top-5-areas-of-focus): Tim Twigg and Rebecca Boartfield on pandemic leadership and OSHA compliance
- [Dentists: What to do when your 'give a damn' is busted](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14185304/dentists-what-to-do-when-your-give-a-damn-is-busted): Dr. Natalie Whitaker addresses dentist burnout and self-care strategies

## Patient Communication & Financing

- [Patient Communication and Patient Financing](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/patient-communication-and-patient-financing): Hub for patient communication, financing options, and case acceptance tactics
- [Overcoming the obstacle of affordability](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14189613/overcoming-the-obstacle-of-affordability): Dr. Chris Salierno addresses patient affordability barriers and case acceptance
- [Grow your practice and reduce reliance on PPOs with a dental membership program!](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14167873/grow-your-practice-and-reduce-reliance-on-ppos-with-a-dental-membership-program-sponsored): BoomCloud sponsored article on dental membership programs and PPO alternatives
- [How to win the battle for new patients by accepting your lack of control](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14072657/how-to-win-the-battle-for-new-patients-by-accepting-your-lack-of-control): Graig Presti on patient acquisition strategy amid market disruption

## Practice Economics & Transitions

- [Real Estate](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/real-estate): Topic hub for practice expansion, acquisitions, and real estate strategy
- [The state of dental transitions following the shutdown](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/14177443/the-state-of-dental-transitions-following-the-shutdown): Brian Hanks analyzes practice sales, valuations, and DSO competition trends
- [Finances on the brink](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/money/article/14035719/finances-on-the-brink): Article on financial management and debt planning for dental professionals
- [How the new emergency paid sick leave law affects your practice](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/money/article/14179545/how-the-new-emergency-paid-sick-leave-law-affects-your-practice): John K. McGill explains Families First Coronavirus Response Act compliance

## Optional

- [IC System](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/sponsored/ic-system): Sponsored content hub for IC System debt collection and revenue management
- [Dental Economics - March 2026](https://digital.dentaleconomics.com/dentaleconomics/202603): Digital archive issue of Dental Economics magazine for March 2026
